verses.en: Perish the two hands of Abū Lahab, and perish he!

verses.ar: مَا٘ اَغۡنٰي عَنۡهُ مَالُهٗ وَمَا كَسَبَؕ‏
verses.en: Neither his wealth benefited him, nor what he earned.
He will soon enter a Fire, full of flames,
and his wife as well,-the wicked carrier of firewood.
Around her neck, there is (a collar of iron, like) a well-twisted rope.
